title: Text-to-CAD Evaluation with CADTests
abstract: arXiv:2605.07807v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Text-to-CAD has recently emerged as an important task with the potential to substantially accelerate design workflows. Despite its significance, there has been surprisingly little work on Text-to-CAD evaluation, and assessing CAD model generation performance remains a considerable challenge. In this work, we introduce a new evaluation perspective for Text-to-CAD based on automated testing. We propose CADTestBench, the first test-based benchmark for Text-to-CAD, based on CADTests, executable software tests that verify whether a generated CAD model satisfies the geometric and topological requirements of the input prompt. Using CADTestBench, we conduct comprehensive benchmarking of recent Text-to-CAD methods and further demonstrate that CADTests can also guide CAD model generation, yielding simple baselines that surpass performance of current methods. CADTestBench code and data are available.

translated_abstract: 文本转CAD（Text-to-CAD）近来已成为一项重要任务，具有大幅加速设计工作流程的潜力。尽管其意义重大，但令人惊讶的是，关于文本转CAD评估的研究工作却很少，评估CAD模型生成性能仍然是一个相当大的挑战。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种基于自动化测试的文本转CAD新评估视角。我们提出了CADTestBench，这是首个基于测试的文本转CAD基准，其基于CADTests构建——这是一类可执行的软件测试，用于验证生成的CAD模型是否满足输入提示词中的几何和拓扑要求。利用CADTestBench，我们对近期的文本转CAD方法进行了全面的基准测试，并进一步证明CADTests还可以用于指导CAD模型生成，由此得到的简单基线方法能够超越现有方法的性能。CADTestBench的代码和数据均已公开可用。
tldr: 该论文提出了首个基于可执行测试的文本转CAD评估基准CADTestBench，通过CADTests验证生成模型是否满足几何与拓扑要求，并证明这些测试还能指导CAD生成，使简单基线超越现有方法。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CADTestBench, the first test-based benchmark for Text-to-CAD that uses executable CADTests to verify geometric and topological requirements of generated CAD models, and shows these tests can also guide generation, yielding simple baselines that surpass current methods.
